en: Black-and-white coastal scene showing a narrow shoreline path lined with fishing nets laid out to dry and several wooden fishing boats pulled up along the water's edge. To the right, there is a rocky beach and simple wooden piers extending into a calm sea with a few small boats moored. On the left hillside rise dense trees and several villas or pavilions, including a prominent multi‑story house on top of the hill and a veranda-style wooden building closer to the path. A small building by the path bears a sign above its windows. The overall look is of an early 20th‑century European seaside resort and fishing village.
